concepts.front: Spin–orbit coupling in a central potential
concepts.definition: In a central potential energy V(r), the nonrelativistic fine-structure interaction is proportional to L·S.
concepts.when_to_use: Includes the Thomas factor; this V is potential energy, not electric potential.
concepts.textbook_context: Shankar (2nd ed.), Ch. 12: Angular Momentum, Ch. 13: Hydrogen Atom, Ch. 17: Time-Independent Perturbation Theory; Griffiths & Schroeter (3rd ed.), Ch. 4 and Ch. 7.

concepts.front: Allowed j values for electron spin
concepts.definition: Combining orbital l with spin s=1/2 yields total angular momenta j=l±1/2, except l=0 has j=1/2 only.

concepts.when_to_use: The linear Zeeman formula assumes a suitable weak-field coupling regime.
